name: chart-pie

frames.best_why: All three pies are fully drawn with their centre totals and slice labels, and no tooltip covers them.

tagline: Donut and pie charts with centre totals, labels and a month picker.
summary: Three dark chart cards: a donut with a total in its hole, an interactive donut whose value changes with a month selector, and a pie with value labels on each slice.
appearance: Three bordered dark cards hold grey pie charts. The first two are donuts with big centre numbers and a Visitors caption, the third a full pie with number labels around the rim.
behaviour: The sectors sweep in when the cards appear. Choosing a month in the second card re-highlights its slice and updates the centre number, while hovering any slice shows a tooltip.
demo_content: Visitor split by browser Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge and Other, with months January to April.
search_phrases: donut chart with total in the middle
use_when: A dashboard needs to show a simple part-to-whole split in a compact card.
avoid_when: Charts hardcode browser and month data, so real figures need the source arrays replaced.
customise: Each variant hardcodes its data, titles and chart config; adapting means replacing arrays and labels in the file.
weight_why: Three small SVG pie charts with a short draw-in; no continuous loop.

a11y.note: The month picker is keyboard reachable, but slices have no roles or names and tooltips are pointer-only.

polish_why: Tidy standard pie cards, but all grey and visually similar.
title: Pie Chart
